name: Oculus Illusions
label: Quest
description: Oculus Illusions: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: So the traveler wishes to become one of the Black Flight, eh?

The creation of the illusion you require is trivial, but the components required for the divination are quite difficult to obtain. Rexxar and the Warchief have entrusted you with this mission, so Myranda must assume you as capable.
Travel to the upper citadel of Blackrock Spire and slay enough of the black dragonspawn to fill up one of your packs with their eyes.
Return to Myranda when you have gathered enough of the reagent.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The eyes of that which we wish to mimic are the most important ingredient of any illusion, friend.
Myranda points to a bag almost overflowing with eyeballs labeled 'Scarlet Crusade.'

clips.title: Completion
paras: Let Myranda have a look, traveler.
Oh yes, these will do nicely.
With these reagents, Myranda will create for you a medallion that will grant an illusion capable of fooling the black dragonflight's gatekeeper.
